text: To organize the decision, it is recommended to poll each member of the group regarding their availability for Tuesday, Thursday, both, or neither. A deadline for responses should be established. If one day is found to be suitable for all members, that day can be proposed as the meeting day. If neither Tuesday nor Thursday is suitable, the conflicting availability should be shared with the group and an alternative option can be explored. It is essential to note that silence or lack of response should not be assumed as agreement. Once a final arrangement is reached, it should be confirmed with the group.
